messages:
Maia (CS): quick sync - 18 onboarding customers seeing stalled ingestion after last night's index migration. need customer-facing status + RCA plan.
Ravi (CS): blocking activations or just delays? which are high-touch?
Maia (CS): activations blocked for ~12 tenants; 6 delayed but working. high-touch: Acme, BrightRoom, StudyAI.
Leo (Eng): root cause: dedupe shard rebalance created a write backlog and retries causing backpressure. applied a targeted patch at 03:24 UTC to skip heavy dedupe.
Leo (Eng): rollback of aggressive dedupe window freed throughput. reindexing ~600 docs/min. ETA ~90-120m for top 3.
Tess (Product): comms recs: 1) status email with ETA + mitigation, 2) offer 2 credits + enablement office hour, 3) full RCA follow-up.
Maia (CS): draft for customers: "We're aware of delayed ingestion after last night's migration. Engineers applied a mitigation; reindexing is underway and we expect priority tenants to catch up within ~2 hours. We'll follow up with a full RCA and an office hour for affected teams."
Ravi (CS): add contact path, incident link, and credit details. e.g., "reply to your account team; we'll apply a one-time credit of 2 platform days."
Leo (Eng): long-term fix: rate-limit dedupe during migrations and add per-tenant queue isolation. will include in RCA.
deploy-bot: Deployed fix v2026.6.14-dedup-patch to prod at 1716662080. All checks green.
Maia (CS): I'll send status email in 10m. Ravi, own replies for Acme + BrightRoom?
Ravi (CS): taking Acme. pinging BrightRoom lead.
Tess (Product): scheduling office hour 11:00 UTC today; will include feedback poll.
Maia (CS): after office hour we'll consolidate feedback into the RCA. tagging follow-ups: @Leo infra post-mortem, @Tess timeline, @Ravi comm log. sending email now.
